items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring. Rapoport and ETR corroborated (was doubtful path).
items.why: Hamstring injury from Week 1, limited/downgraded Saturday.
items.implication: BAL WR room crumbs; elevated TE/WR usage for Andrews and others.
items.opportunity: Mark Andrews target share spike (saw high % post-Flowers exit W1); other BAL WRs limited hierarchy.

items.text: TE Brock Bowers doubtful for Sunday; Raiders elevated TE Chris Myarick and WR Cody White. ETR listed OUT/DOUBTFUL.
items.why: Knee injury; elevations signal low play probability.
items.implication: Sit Bowers; LV TE/WR volume to backups/Myarick or Mayer.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer or elevated TE routes/targets increase.

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT vs Patriots with foot injury. Schefter confirmed; was Q on ETR board.
items.implication: PIT WR volume opens; start other PIT options or stream.
items.opportunity: DK Metcalf or other PIT WRs see increased targets/routes.

items.text: Nico Collins ruled OUT with hamstring (Grade 1 strain, possible multi-week). ETR listed in OUT/DOUBTFUL board; Schefter/Rapoport confirmed. Opens volume in HOU passing game.
items.why: Missed practice all week, hamstring strain confirmed via beat/insider reports.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; HOU WRs/TE surge in opportunity.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes previously 10+ for Collins shift to Schultz, Boutte, Hutchinson, Noel.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed questionable for MNF vs Giants (hip/groin soreness, no practice Fri/Sat). McVay: pre-game decision, not camp-related. Whittington doubtful.
items.why: Hip injury with groin soreness post-Thursday; missed consecutive practices.
items.implication: Have pivot ready for MNF; if out, LAR TE/WR redistribution.
items.opportunity: If OUT, TEs Ferguson/Parkinson and remaining WRs (Mumpfield) get routes/targets; reverse if IN.

items.text: Joe Burrow questionable (back) but expected/good to go; Bengals elevated Josh Johnson. ETR noted 'said he's playing'; coach/Taylor positive.
items.why: Burrow called missing 'ridiculous'; Taylor indicated good to go; elevation precautionary.
items.implication: Start Burrow confidently; CIN offense full strength expected.
items.opportunity: Full snap/route tree for Chase/Higgins if Burrow active as projected.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest injury on the slate; affects Justin Herbert projections and many others. Game at 4pm ET. ETR Q board.
items.why: Ribs injury; highest leverage Q per Levitan data/projections assumptions.
items.implication: Monitor closely; if out, LAC WR hierarchy shifts (Johnston boost) and Herbert ceiling drops.
items.opportunity: Quentin Johnston routes/targets up if McConkey limited/out; Herbert pass volume/efficiency impact.

items.text: Patriots desperately need playmakers; do they give TreVeyon Henderson 10+ touches in 2026 debut? ETR listed IN. Stevenson present but opportunity high.
items.why: Debut set; NE playmaker need + practice full; potential committee expansion.
items.implication: Henderson flex/RB2 upside if 10+ touches; monitor Stevenson split.
items.opportunity: Carries, routes, third-down/two-minute possible expansion vs Stevenson.
items.conflict: Stevenson still lead but volume available.

items.text: Alvin Kamara expected back (ETR IN); squeezes Travis Etienne who matched Kendre Miller rushes W1 with air-heavy production. Berry HATES Etienne.
items.why: Kamara return creates three-headed committee; Etienne W1 usage already split/concerning for script as underdogs.
items.implication: Fade Etienne; Kamara reclaims passing downs/goal-line.
items.opportunity: Kamara snaps/routes/targets/third-down up; Etienne early-down only possible.

items.text: Giving Christian McCaffrey a bump off Week 1 usage regardless, but Kaelon Black (groin) status matters for SF RB split.
items.why: Strong W1 usage baseline; Black Q could further consolidate.
items.implication: CMC elite RB1 with potential even higher share.
items.opportunity: Snaps, carries, routes, red-zone already high; Black limited expands further.

items.text: Berry LOVES Kenneth Walker vs IND: 74% snaps, 21/24 RB touches through 3Q W1, 40% target rate tying team lead. IND gave 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite W1 utilization (touches + pass game) + soft IND run matchup.
items.implication: Strong RB1 start; high floor/ceiling from dual usage.
items.opportunity: Snap share, target share on routes, red-zone carries confirmed high.

items.text: Berry LOVES Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization score W1 (tied Bijan), 19% target share last 10 games, 25+ touches 3/4 recent.
items.why: Near-max utilization + consistent pass-game role + favorable road matchup.
items.implication: RB1/high-end RB2 lock with volume security.
items.opportunity: Touches, target share, red-zone work elite.

items.text: Berry LOVES Bucky Irving vs CLE: RB9 utilization W1, 26% target share, 100% RB red-zone touches. CLE soft vs run; out-routed Gainwell.
items.implication: Strong start; dual-threat RB2/flex with TD upside.
items.opportunity: Routes, targets, red-zone/goal-line carries locked in.

items.text: Berry LOVES Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz W1; 93 yds/18 PPG career with Wentz. Bears soft vs WRs recently.
items.why: Massive Wentz volume + historical chemistry + matchup.
items.implication: WR1 smash spot despite QB change (Murray out).
items.opportunity: Target share, aDOT, routes dominant with Wentz.
